legal.hook: Bombay High Court quashes FIR against B.Tech student for Instagram repost on Operation Sindoor
legal.summary: The Bombay High Court quashed an FIR against a B.Tech student, identified as Saurabh Soni, who had reposted content related to 'Operation Sindoor' on Instagram. The FIR was filed under Sections 153A (promoting enmity between different groups) and 505(2) (statements creating or promoting enmity, hatred, or ill-will) of the Indian Penal Code. The court found that the repost did not incite violence or hatred and emphasized the importance of free speech. Justice Nitin W. Sambre stated that the FIR was an abuse of the legal process, as the repost was merely a sharing of information without any malicious intent. The court's decision reinforces the protection of individual expression on social media platforms in India.
legal.contextNote: This ruling highlights the judiciary's stance on the balance between free speech and public order under the Indian Penal Code.
